W-edge strip 47.52 x 432 placed at tile (22.464, 345.6): its W pins sit at the tile's W-face pin offsets (n_a 356.4-455.9, n_b 457-556.5, t_out 557.5-657, n_y 658-757.5), M4. Own short clock root (~12.1k sinks); removes the node + t_out flop->port classes from the flat 34-48k-sink tile root.
